program.name: Easy Strength
program.subject: Gentle / low impact
program.blurb: Slow, simple strength in straight sets, then a gentle stretch. Every rep calm and controlled.
program.about: Slow, simple strength for building up gently. Each session is a few straight sets of moves like sit-to-stands, wall push-ups and bridges, with full rests, then a gentle stretch on the floor. Level II slows every rep down, which makes it harder without adding anything, and Level III adds a few reps.
